2607.18665.title: SciHazard: A Benchmark for Measuring Scientific Safety Risks with Decomposed Harm Scoring
2607.18665.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support science, but they can also convert hazardous scientific knowledge into actionable misuse guidance. Existing benchmarks often rely on templated queries disconnected from real-world hazards, and employ LLM-as-a-Judge paradigms without domain grounding. To address this, we introduce SciHazard, a real-world-grounded benchmark for scientific risks and a dataset agnostic evaluation framework for measuring harmfulness. SciHazard contains 2400 hazardous questions and 600 oversafety questions across 12 disciplines, with both queries grounded in regulated entities and documented failure scenarios. To compute \textsc{DeHarm-Score} , we develop a decomposed evaluating procedure that combines query hazard severity, refusal behavior, and response-level risk. For non-refused responses, it further decomposes response-level harm into \textsc{Executability}, quantified via dynamic checklists with importance weighting, and \textsc{Net-new risk}, assessed through retrieval-augmented claim extraction and synthesis-barrier verification. An expert-validation study shows that \textsc{DeHarm-Score} improves agreement with expert annotations by 90.17\% over the strongest baseline. We benchmark 31 frontier LLMs and deep research agents in an extensive scientific safety evaluation. Notably, deep research agents yield 32.3\% higher mean \textsc{DeHarm-Score} than standard LLMs, exposing autonomous agents as a critical blind spot in current safety defenses. Code and dataset are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeharmScore-7B55.
2607.18665.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地支持科學，但它們也可能將危險的科學知識轉化為可行的誤用指導。現有的基準通常依賴於與現實世界危害脫節的模板查詢，並採用沒有領域基礎的LLM作為評判者的範式。為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了SciHazard，這是一個基於現實世界的科學風險基準和一個無關數據集的評估框架，用於測量有害性。SciHazard包含2400個危險問題和600個過度安全問題，涵蓋12個學科，這些查詢均以受規範的實體和記錄的失敗場景為基礎。為了計算\textsc{DeHarm-Score}，我們開發了一個分解評估程序，結合了查詢危害嚴重性、拒絕行為和回應層級風險。對於未被拒絕的回應，它進一步將回應層級的傷害分解為\textsc{Executability}，通過動態檢查清單和重要性加權進行量化，以及\textsc{Net-new risk}，通過檢索增強的主張提取和綜合障礙驗證進行評估。一項專家驗證研究顯示，\textsc{DeHarm-Score}在與專家註釋的一致性上比最強基線提高了90.17\%。我們在一個廣泛的科學安全評估中基準測試了31個前沿LLMs和深度研究代理。值得注意的是，深度研究代理的平均\textsc{DeHarm-Score}比標準LLMs高出32.3\%，揭示了自主代理在當前安全防禦中的一個關鍵盲點。代碼和數據集可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DeharmScore-7B55獲得。
